mapper.select: select resv_id, COALESCE((SELECT f.bk_file_ori_name FROM lib_file_book f WHERE r.book_id = f.book_id), '') AS file_name, r.book_id, title, author, publisher, userid from lib_resv r inner join lib_books b ON b.book_id = r.book_id where (title like CONCAT('%', #{sKey}, '%') or author like CONCAT('%', #{sKey}, '%')) and userid = #{userid} order by resv_id desc limit #{recordCountPerPage} offset #{firstIndex}
select count(*) from lib_resv r inner join lib_books b ON b.book_id = r.book_id where (title like CONCAT('%', #{sKey}, '%') or author like CONCAT('%', #{sKey}, '%')) and userid = #{userid}
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(l.loan_state), 'N') AS loan_state FROM lib_loans l WHERE l.userid = #{userid} AND l.book_id = #{bookId}
